policy.notes: External tools are pinned to verified upstream repositories before activation. Active testing is restricted to systems the user owns or is explicitly authorized to assess. Satellite features are passive reception/analysis or simulator/lab-only. Media-forensics results are evidentiary signals rather than binary truth or deepfake verdicts. Address correlation is limited to lawfully accessible public/business/owned records. Firewall testing is limited to owned or explicitly authorized infrastructure and lab environments.

adapters.name: Privacy / OpSec Self-Audit
adapters.purpose: Visible-IP/VPN checks, browser fingerprint awareness, WebRTC checks, tracking-link cleanup, metadata stripping and identity compartment guidance

adapters.name: Impersonation Defense Case Builder
adapters.purpose: Preserve public evidence, compare profile images locally, document inconsistencies and generate a reporting packet without doxxing

adapters.name: Public Address Correlation
adapters.purpose: Correlate lawfully accessible public addresses with organizations, domains, public filings and other sourced records while preserving source URLs, timestamps and confidence levels

adapters.name: Media / Authenticity Forensics
adapters.purpose: Local hashing and first-pass media/text triage, then structured worker analysis for provenance, metadata conflicts, edits, discontinuities and internal inconsistencies

adapters.name: FFmpeg / FFprobe Media Inspection
adapters.purpose: Inspect streams, codecs, timestamps, frame rates, duration, keyframes, scene boundaries and audio/video container structure

adapters.name: OpenCV Frame Analysis
adapters.purpose: Frame sampling, duplicate-frame detection, visual discontinuity analysis and image-region consistency checks

adapters.name: C2PA Content Credentials Check
adapters.purpose: Check for signed C2PA provenance/content credentials when present. Absence of credentials is not evidence that content is fake.

adapters.name: Metadata / Container Forensics
adapters.purpose: Inspect timestamps, software tags, device fields, dimensions, codec/container metadata and conflicts between metadata sources

adapters.name: Sherlock Username Discovery
adapters.purpose: Find public accounts using the same username across supported sites for self-audit and impersonation investigations

adapters.name: OSIRIS Global Intelligence
adapters.purpose: Situational awareness, public data layers, DNS/WHOIS/IP/CVE enrichment and map-based OSINT

adapters.name: Shadowbroker Intelligence Dashboard
adapters.purpose: Aggregate public aviation, satellite, CCTV, event and intelligence feeds for situational awareness

adapters.name: Nmap Network Discovery
adapters.purpose: Authorized network inventory, port and service discovery

adapters.name: Authorized Firewall / Segmentation Assessment
adapters.purpose: Validate firewall policy enforcement, exposed services, segmentation boundaries, ingress/egress behavior, rule drift and WAF/firewall configuration on owned or explicitly authorized infrastructure

adapters.name: Nuclei Vulnerability Assessment
adapters.purpose: Template-based vulnerability assessment of authorized applications and infrastructure

adapters.name: ZAP Web Application Testing
adapters.purpose: Authorized web application security testing and DAST

adapters.name: CrowdSec Detection / Blocking
adapters.purpose: Detect abusive behavior and feed block/remediation decisions for owned infrastructure

adapters.name: Suricata IDS / IPS
adapters.purpose: Intrusion detection, prevention and network-security monitoring on owned networks

adapters.name: OpenCanary Honeypot
adapters.purpose: Decoy services and alerts when scanners or intruders touch resources that legitimate users should not access

adapters.name: gr-satellites Telemetry Decoder
adapters.purpose: Passive demodulation and decoding of supported amateur-satellite telemetry

adapters.name: SatDump Satellite Data Processing
adapters.purpose: Passive satellite signal/data processing and decoding

adapters.name: NASA NOS3 Space-System Simulator
adapters.purpose: Space-system simulation and safe security experiments against a lab/digital twin rather than live spacecraft
